body:
selfhost/emit.prn now constructs a real, non-pointer-shaped I32 Ok/Err/Some payload via a genuine per-type heap-box helper (int_box), the natural complement to earlier deref support -- together completing the full round trip: a value can now be produced and consumed, scalar payload included, entirely by real selfhost-emitted C on both ends. New int-box-helper-decl (always emitted, matching the file's own simple-over-optimized convention), result-option-payload-is-i32?, and arena-scope-any-ref (finds a destination arena to box into, with an honest self-documenting-invalid fallback for the degenerate no-arena case). 7 new tests including a real compile+run+assert check proving construction and consumption both entirely selfhost-emitted. Zero regressions: 336-test suite + all 6 selfhost domains + bazel build/test clean. PARENA commit a68e05c.

⚓ ☃
title: Self-hosted compiler: real I32 Ok/Err/Some payload construction, closing the full round trip
